Simulate a 2D lid-driven cavity flow using OpenFOAM with the icoFoam solver.
Use an incompressible laminar flow model.
Use a square domain of 0.1 m by 0.1 m.
Use a uniform mesh of 20 by 20 cells created with blockMesh.
Set the top wall to move to the right at 1 m/s.
Set all other walls to no-slip fixed walls.
Set the front and back faces to empty boundary conditions.
Set the Reynolds number to 100, with kinematic viscosity of 0.001 m²/s.
Set startTime to 0 s.
Set deltaT to 0.002 s.
Set endTime to 0.5 s.
Configure the simulation in system/controlDict, with velocity and pressure fields defined in 0/U and 0/p.
